record.title: Aluna
record.year_scope: Film year stated by Tairona Heritage Trust and The Film Collaborative; the selected official YouTube edition was uploaded February 4, 2018.
record.credits: Directed and produced by Alan Ereira; executive producer Ben Woolford.
record.publisher: Aluna - The Movie / Tairona Heritage Trust
record.location: Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta and Caribbean coast, Colombia
record.synopsis: Kogi participants explore links between land and ecological change along Colombia’s Caribbean coast. Their own footage and commentary from Western scientists convey an environmental warning.
record.perspective: The Tairona Heritage Trust describes a film made with Kogi participants, including footage they shot themselves. It presents those participants’ perspectives and does not speak for every Kogi person or Indigenous community.
record.availability: The official film channel publishes this complete edition free on YouTube. Only English auto-generated captions are listed. Regional or account limits may apply; actual playback and caption quality are unverified.
record.content_note: Discusses ecological damage and threats to land and water.

sources.title: Aluna - An Ecological Warning by the Kogi People

capture_policy: All factual HTML and robots captures remain in the scoped local scratch directory. Individual receipts mark capture_retention:local. Only short original summaries,metadata and measured receipt hashes are proposed for Git.
